subject: Containing Wi-Fi Regulatory Domain Rollbacks after Border Roaming
title_ko: 국경 로밍 이후 Wi-Fi 규제 도메인 Rollback 현장 대응
summary_ko: 가상의 Android 현장 품질 회의에서 국경 로밍 뒤 지연된 modem snapshot이 최신 국가 설정을 되돌려 6GHz 연결을 끊는 문제를 분석합니다. 팀들은 monotonic evidence ledger, journey-safe 상태, 검증된 expansion token, signed rule set과 정량 compliance·reconnection gate를 결정합니다. 모든 인물·조직·단말·국가·통신망·SIM·access point·chipset·firmware·빌드·로그·결함·수치·일정은 Business English 교육을 위한 가상 설정이며 실제 기업이나 제품의 실제 결함을 주장하지 않습니다.

turns.speaker: Mina Park
turns.en: Good morning. Field Quality, Connectivity Framework, Wi-Fi BSP and Firmware, and Carrier and Regulatory Validation are represented. We are reviewing reports that 6 GHz Wi-Fi disappears several minutes after a traveler lands, inserts a local SIM, and connects successfully to a hotel access point. The device initially selects the correct country, then silently returns to the previous region and disconnects. We need to distinguish a regulatory protection from an incorrect rollback. Today's outcome must define the authoritative evidence, a safe field mitigation, permanent ownership, measurable gates, and a dated follow-up. We will not trade regulatory compliance for a faster reconnection.
turns.ko: 좋은 아침입니다. Field Quality, Connectivity Framework, Wi-Fi BSP and Firmware, Carrier and Regulatory Validation 팀이 참석했습니다. 여행자가 도착해 현지 SIM을 넣고 호텔 access point에 성공적으로 연결한 뒤 몇 분 후 6GHz Wi-Fi가 사라진다는 보고를 검토합니다. 단말은 처음 올바른 국가를 선택하지만 조용히 이전 지역으로 돌아가 연결이 끊깁니다. 규제 보호와 잘못된 rollback을 구분해야 합니다. 오늘 authoritative evidence, 안전한 현장 완화책, 영구 담당, 측정 gate, 날짜가 있는 후속 일정을 정해야 합니다. 빠른 재연결을 위해 규제 준수를 희생하지 않습니다.

turns.speaker: Owen Miller
turns.en: Carrier and Regulatory Validation is present. We reproduced 42 failures in 1,200 border-roaming cycles across three destination countries. Every device first adopted the local cellular country code and enabled a permitted 6 GHz channel. Between 190 and 430 seconds later, a delayed modem service indication replayed the departure country from its persisted registration snapshot. Framework accepted that value as newer because it arrived later, although its source measurement was older. The access point remained legal in the destination, but the device removed the channel and fell back to 5 GHz. We saw no illegal transmission; the customer impact is repeated disconnection and missing 6 GHz availability.
turns.ko: Carrier and Regulatory Validation 팀이 참석했습니다. 세 도착 국가의 border-roaming cycle 1,200회에서 실패 42회를 재현했습니다. 모든 단말은 먼저 현지 cellular country code를 적용하고 허용된 6GHz channel을 활성화했습니다. 190~430초 뒤 지연된 modem service indication이 persisted registration snapshot의 출발 국가를 재생했습니다. source measurement는 더 오래됐지만 나중에 도착했다는 이유로 framework가 더 새로운 값으로 수락했습니다. access point는 도착지에서 합법이었지만 단말은 channel을 제거하고 5GHz로 fallback했습니다. 불법 송신은 없었고 고객 영향은 반복 disconnect와 6GHz availability 상실입니다.

turns.speaker: Liam Chen
turns.en: Connectivity Framework is here. The current policy ranks sources by arrival order after boot: modem, network location, access-point hint, then default world domain. It does not carry observation time or a journey boundary. That design assumed modem indications were monotonic. The delayed snapshot violates that assumption. I do not want to solve this by permanently preferring location, because location can be unavailable indoors and an access-point hint is not sufficient regulatory authority. I propose a source record containing observed time, subscription identity, modem registration generation, confidence class, and expiry. A country transition should be a committed transaction, not a loose sequence of callbacks.
turns.ko: Connectivity Framework 팀이 참석했습니다. 현재 policy는 boot 후 arrival order로 modem, network location, access-point hint, default world domain source를 순위화합니다. observation time이나 journey boundary가 없습니다. 이 설계는 modem indication이 monotonic이라고 가정했습니다. 지연 snapshot이 그 가정을 깨뜨립니다. location은 실내에서 unavailable할 수 있고 access-point hint만으로는 규제 authority가 충분하지 않으므로 location을 영구 우선하는 방식은 원하지 않습니다. observed time, subscription identity, modem registration generation, confidence class, expiry를 담는 source record를 제안합니다. 국가 전환은 느슨한 callback sequence가 아니라 committed transaction이어야 합니다.

turns.speaker: Elena Rossi
turns.en: Wi-Fi BSP and Firmware is present. Firmware receives only a two-letter country and an update sequence generated by framework. It cannot tell whether a later sequence represents fresher evidence. When the country changes, firmware stops affected radios, rebuilds the channel table, and reconnects on a permitted channel. That conservative behavior prevented illegal operation, so the disconnect is not proof of a firmware defect. However, firmware reports only 'country applied,' not which radios were stopped, whether the table became more or less restrictive, or which connection was displaced. We need an acknowledgment that echoes transaction identity, effective rule-set digest, and transition class without exposing location.
turns.ko: Wi-Fi BSP and Firmware 팀이 참석했습니다. firmware는 framework가 생성한 update sequence와 두 글자 country만 받습니다. 나중 sequence가 더 최신 evidence인지 판단할 수 없습니다. country가 바뀌면 firmware는 영향 radio를 멈추고 channel table을 재구성해 허용 channel로 재연결합니다. 이 보수적 동작이 불법 operation을 막았으므로 disconnect가 firmware defect의 증거는 아닙니다. 다만 firmware는 'country applied'만 보고하고 어떤 radio가 멈췄는지, table이 더 제한적이 됐는지, 어떤 connection이 밀려났는지 알리지 않습니다. location을 노출하지 않으면서 transaction identity, effective rule-set digest, transition class를 echo하는 acknowledgment가 필요합니다.

turns.speaker: Mina Park
turns.en: Let us anchor one representative trace. At 08:14:02, the local SIM registers with modem generation 73 and country DK. At 08:14:09, framework commits DK transaction 501 after cellular confirmation and a coarse network-location match. At 08:14:12, firmware applies rule-set digest A91 and the device joins channel 69. At 08:19:37, modem service restarts and emits persisted generation 68 with country DE. Framework creates transaction 502 because the callback is new. Firmware applies the more restrictive digest C44 and disconnects. At 08:19:40, live modem registration still says generation 73. Which component must reject the stale evidence?
turns.ko: 대표 trace 하나를 고정합시다. 08:14:02에 현지 SIM이 modem generation 73, country DK로 등록합니다. 08:14:09에 framework는 cellular confirmation과 coarse network-location match 뒤 DK transaction 501을 commit합니다. 08:14:12에 firmware가 rule-set digest A91을 적용하고 단말은 channel 69에 연결합니다. 08:19:37에 modem service가 restart하며 persisted generation 68, country DE를 냅니다. callback이 새로 왔다는 이유로 framework가 transaction 502를 만듭니다. firmware는 더 제한적인 digest C44를 적용하고 disconnect합니다. 08:19:40의 live modem registration은 여전히 generation 73입니다. 어느 component가 stale evidence를 거부해야 합니까?

turns.speaker: Liam Chen
turns.en: Framework must reject it before proposing a country transaction. Generation 68 is older than the accepted generation 73 for the same subscription epoch. Arrival time cannot override source age. I propose a monotonic evidence ledger keyed by subscription epoch and boot session. The ledger accepts a modem record only if its registration generation advances or if a new subscription epoch is proven. A service restart does not create a new epoch. If generation is absent, the record enters uncertain state and cannot loosen the current domain. It may request a live refresh, and during uncertainty the device keeps the intersection of current and world-safe channels.
turns.ko: country transaction을 제안하기 전에 framework가 거부해야 합니다. 같은 subscription epoch에서 generation 68은 수락된 73보다 오래됐습니다. arrival time이 source age를 덮어쓸 수 없습니다. subscription epoch와 boot session을 key로 하는 monotonic evidence ledger를 제안합니다. ledger는 registration generation이 증가하거나 새 subscription epoch가 증명될 때만 modem record를 수락합니다. service restart는 새 epoch를 만들지 않습니다. generation이 없으면 record는 uncertain state로 들어가 current domain을 완화할 수 없습니다. live refresh를 요청하며 uncertainty 동안 단말은 current와 world-safe channel의 intersection을 유지합니다.

turns.speaker: Owen Miller
turns.en: I disagree with keeping the current domain during all uncertainty. If the traveler physically moved but neither modem generation nor location is ready, retaining a permissive departure domain could authorize a channel that is not legal at the destination. The safe baseline must never be broader than world domain when movement is plausible. We need a journey trigger: airplane-mode duration, SIM country change, large time-zone change, or loss of the previous network for more than four hours. After a journey trigger, uncertain evidence should narrow to world-safe operation until two independent signals agree or one high-authority live modem registration is verified.
turns.ko: 모든 uncertainty에서 current domain을 유지하는 데는 반대합니다. 여행자가 실제 이동했지만 modem generation이나 location이 준비되지 않았다면 permissive departure domain을 유지해 도착지에서 불법인 channel을 허용할 수 있습니다. movement 가능성이 있으면 안전 baseline은 world domain보다 넓어서는 안 됩니다. journey trigger가 필요합니다. airplane-mode duration, SIM country change, 큰 time-zone change, 이전 network 4시간 이상 상실입니다. journey trigger 뒤 uncertain evidence는 두 independent signal이 일치하거나 high-authority live modem registration 하나가 확인될 때까지 world-safe operation으로 좁혀야 합니다.

turns.speaker: Elena Rossi
turns.en: Firmware can support that policy if transitions are explicit. Today it receives country updates without a mode. Add transition classes: confirmed-country, journey-safe, stale-rejected, and emergency-restrict. Journey-safe maps to a signed world-safe rule set and disables 6 GHz without pretending a specific country. Confirmed-country may expand only after framework provides a verified evidence token. Emergency-restrict can immediately remove channels on regulatory risk. Firmware must never expand from a timeout or missing token. It will return applied digest, radio impact, and reconnect reason. This makes protective narrowing visible and separates it from an accidental rollback.
turns.ko: transition이 명시적이면 firmware가 그 policy를 지원할 수 있습니다. 현재는 mode 없이 country update를 받습니다. confirmed-country, journey-safe, stale-rejected, emergency-restrict transition class를 추가합시다. journey-safe는 signed world-safe rule set으로 mapping되고 특정 country인 척하지 않으면서 6GHz를 비활성화합니다. confirmed-country는 framework가 verified evidence token을 제공한 뒤에만 확장할 수 있습니다. emergency-restrict는 regulatory risk 때 channel을 즉시 제거할 수 있습니다. firmware는 timeout이나 missing token에서 절대 확장하지 않습니다. applied digest, radio impact, reconnect reason을 반환합니다. 보호를 위한 narrowing을 보이게 하고 accidental rollback과 분리합니다.

turns.speaker: Mina Park
turns.en: We have three options. First, disable 6 GHz for all roaming devices until the next monthly update. That is simple but penalizes travelers who are unaffected. Second, ignore every modem country callback for ten minutes after initial registration. That masks the known delay but can suppress a legitimate move or SIM switch. Third, implement the evidence ledger, journey-safe state, verified expansion token, and firmware acknowledgment, while using a narrow server-side field mitigation for the affected build. My preference is option three. The field mitigation may force journey-safe after a stale generation, but it must not select a country or broaden channels remotely.
turns.ko: 세 가지 option이 있습니다. 첫째, 다음 monthly update까지 모든 roaming device에서 6GHz를 끕니다. 단순하지만 영향 없는 여행자도 손해를 봅니다. 둘째, initial registration 후 10분간 모든 modem country callback을 무시합니다. 알려진 delay는 가리지만 legitimate move나 SIM switch를 억제할 수 있습니다. 셋째, evidence ledger, journey-safe state, verified expansion token, firmware acknowledgment를 구현하고 affected build에는 좁은 server-side field mitigation을 사용합니다. 3안을 선호합니다. field mitigation은 stale generation 뒤 journey-safe를 강제할 수 있지만 원격으로 country를 선택하거나 channel을 확장하면 안 됩니다.

turns.speaker: Liam Chen
turns.en: Framework accepts option three with a strict invariant: only verified evidence can broaden the rule set, while uncertainty can only preserve or narrow it. The evidence token contains subscription epoch, registration generation, source class, observation-age band, journey identifier, candidate country, and policy version. It contains no coordinates, cell identifiers, access-point identifiers, or raw timestamps. A commit requires either live modem registration plus a matching subscription country, or live modem registration plus coarse network-location agreement. Conflicts remain journey-safe and create a bounded diagnostic. Every transaction ends as applied, stale-rejected, conflict-safe, expired, superseded, or firmware-failed.
turns.ko: Framework는 엄격한 invariant와 함께 3안을 수락합니다. verified evidence만 rule set을 넓힐 수 있고 uncertainty는 유지하거나 좁힐 수만 있습니다. evidence token은 subscription epoch, registration generation, source class, observation-age band, journey identifier, candidate country, policy version을 담습니다. coordinate, cell identifier, access-point identifier, raw timestamp는 담지 않습니다. commit은 live modem registration과 matching subscription country 또는 live modem registration과 coarse network-location agreement가 있어야 합니다. conflict는 journey-safe로 남고 bounded diagnostic을 생성합니다. 모든 transaction은 applied, stale-rejected, conflict-safe, expired, superseded, firmware-failed 중 하나로 끝납니다.

turns.speaker: Elena Rossi
turns.en: Firmware accepts if the signed policy bundle is pinned to the BSP baseline and verified before radio changes. The driver will stage a new table, compare it with the active digest, and classify expansion, restriction, or equal scope. Restriction applies immediately and may disconnect. Expansion waits for the verified token and an acknowledgment from the regulatory engine. If verification fails, the active table is never replaced by a broader one. The acknowledgment includes transaction number, requested class, applied class, old and new digest, affected-band mask, and reconnect outcome. Duplicate transactions return the recorded result and do not cycle the radio.
turns.ko: signed policy bundle이 BSP baseline에 고정되고 radio 변경 전에 검증되면 Firmware는 수락합니다. driver는 새 table을 staging하고 active digest와 비교해 expansion, restriction, equal scope를 분류합니다. restriction은 즉시 적용되며 disconnect할 수 있습니다. expansion은 verified token과 regulatory engine acknowledgment를 기다립니다. verification이 실패하면 active table은 더 넓은 것으로 절대 교체되지 않습니다. acknowledgment에는 transaction number, requested class, applied class, old·new digest, affected-band mask, reconnect outcome이 포함됩니다. duplicate transaction은 기록된 결과를 반환하고 radio를 cycle하지 않습니다.

turns.speaker: Owen Miller
turns.en: Validation will run 9,600 journeys across six country pairs, physical and simulated SIM changes, modem restarts, airplane-mode periods of one to twelve hours, dual-SIM swaps, missing location, conflicting location, and delayed indications up to thirty minutes. Acceptance requires zero illegal-channel dwell, zero expansion without a verified token, zero stale-generation commits, and exactly one terminal result per transaction. A confirmed destination must restore permitted 6 GHz within twenty seconds at p99. Journey-safe entry must occur within two seconds of a risk trigger. Unrelated 2.4 and 5 GHz traffic may not pause longer than 150 milliseconds unless a restriction requires channel evacuation.
turns.ko: Validation은 6개 country pair, physical·simulated SIM change, modem restart, 1~12시간 airplane mode, dual-SIM swap, location 누락, location 충돌, 최대 30분 delayed indication에 걸쳐 journey 9,600회를 실행합니다. illegal-channel dwell 0건, verified token 없는 expansion 0건, stale-generation commit 0건, transaction당 terminal result 정확히 1개를 요구합니다. confirmed destination은 p99 20초 안에 허용된 6GHz를 복구해야 합니다. journey-safe 진입은 risk trigger 후 2초 안이어야 합니다. restriction이 channel evacuation을 요구하지 않는 한 관련 없는 2.4·5GHz traffic은 150ms 넘게 멈추면 안 됩니다.

turns.speaker: Mina Park
turns.en: The decision is option three. We will deploy a field mitigation that detects a lower modem generation after a committed destination and moves only that device to journey-safe. It cannot assign a country, bypass token verification, or expand channels. The permanent fix is a monotonic evidence ledger, explicit journey boundary, verified expansion token, signed policy bundle, and reason-coded firmware acknowledgment. I own the incident record, affected-build targeting, customer-impact dashboard, and go or defer recommendation. Any evidence of illegal transmission stops the mitigation and escalates immediately; ordinary fallback to 5 GHz remains a measured customer-impact event, not a compliance failure.
turns.ko: 결정은 3안입니다. committed destination 뒤 더 낮은 modem generation을 감지하면 해당 단말만 journey-safe로 옮기는 field mitigation을 배포합니다. country를 지정하거나 token verification을 우회하거나 channel을 확장할 수 없습니다. 영구 fix는 monotonic evidence ledger, explicit journey boundary, verified expansion token, signed policy bundle, reason-coded firmware acknowledgment입니다. incident record, affected-build targeting, customer-impact dashboard, go 또는 defer 권고를 담당합니다. illegal transmission 증거가 하나라도 나오면 mitigation을 중단하고 즉시 escalation합니다. 일반적인 5GHz fallback은 compliance failure가 아니라 측정할 customer-impact event로 남습니다.

turns.speaker: Liam Chen
turns.en: I own the ledger, journey detector, token schema, conflict handling, and transaction reconciliation. The interface draft is due Friday, November 27 at 15:00 Korea Standard Time. A reviewable framework build is due Sunday, November 29 at 18:00. By Monday at noon, I will publish tests for service restart, generation rollback, dual-SIM default switch, subscription replacement, missing generation, time-zone-only change, process death, duplicate callback, and policy expiry. The dashboard will separate confirmed expansion, protective restriction, stale rejection, conflict-safe, superseded, and firmware failure. It will report age bands and journey classes, never location history.
turns.ko: ledger, journey detector, token schema, conflict handling, transaction reconciliation을 담당합니다. interface draft는 11월 27일 금요일 한국 표준시 15:00까지입니다. review 가능한 framework build는 11월 29일 일요일 18:00까지입니다. 월요일 정오까지 service restart, generation rollback, dual-SIM default switch, subscription replacement, missing generation, time-zone-only change, process death, duplicate callback, policy expiry test를 게시합니다. dashboard는 confirmed expansion, protective restriction, stale rejection, conflict-safe, superseded, firmware failure를 분리합니다. age band와 journey class를 보고하며 location history는 절대 보고하지 않습니다.

turns.speaker: Elena Rossi
turns.en: I own the staged rule table, digest comparison, regulatory-engine verification, band-impact acknowledgment, and idempotent transaction handling. The firmware command review is November 27 at 17:00 KST. An instrumented build for chipset branches W18 and W19 is due November 30 at 10:00. The signed policy bundle and verification vectors are due the same day at 14:00. If W18 cannot return the full acknowledgment, it remains on journey-safe during roaming rather than inferring success from a generic country-applied event. Engineering traces may include table entry numbers; production telemetry contains digests, masks, classes, durations, and outcomes only.
turns.ko: staged rule table, digest comparison, regulatory-engine verification, band-impact acknowledgment, idempotent transaction handling을 담당합니다. firmware command review는 11월 27일 KST 17:00입니다. chipset branch W18·W19의 instrumented build는 11월 30일 10:00까지입니다. signed policy bundle과 verification vector는 같은 날 14:00까지입니다. W18이 full acknowledgment를 반환할 수 없으면 generic country-applied event로 성공을 추론하지 않고 roaming 동안 journey-safe에 남습니다. engineering trace는 table entry number를 포함할 수 있지만 production telemetry는 digest, mask, class, duration, outcome만 담습니다.

turns.speaker: Owen Miller
turns.en: I own the journey matrix and regulatory review. Static artifact inspection begins November 30 at 16:00 KST, and hardware journeys start December 1 at 08:00. I will publish a 2,400-journey interim ledger on December 2 at 19:00 and the full 9,600-journey report on December 5 at 15:00. Fault injection has a separate 720-case denominator. Any changed framework, driver, firmware, or policy digest starts a new ledger. A hard stop occurs on illegal-channel dwell, unverified expansion, wrong-country commitment, missing terminal outcome, production location leakage, or a duplicate transaction that cycles the radio.
turns.ko: journey matrix와 regulatory review를 담당합니다. static artifact inspection은 11월 30일 KST 16:00에 시작하고 hardware journey는 12월 1일 08:00에 시작합니다. 2,400-journey interim ledger는 12월 2일 19:00까지, 전체 9,600-journey report는 12월 5일 15:00까지 게시합니다. fault injection은 720-case 별도 분모를 가집니다. framework, driver, firmware, policy digest 중 하나라도 바뀌면 새 ledger를 시작합니다. illegal-channel dwell, unverified expansion, wrong-country commitment, terminal outcome 누락, production location leakage, duplicate transaction의 radio cycle이 발생하면 hard stop합니다.

turns.speaker: Mina Park
turns.en: The scope is frozen around country evidence and Wi-Fi rule transitions. We are not changing modem roaming selection, access-point firmware, location accuracy, or general Wi-Fi power policy. Findings there become separate issues. The first evidence checkpoint is Wednesday, December 2, 2026, from 20:00 to 20:45 Korea Standard Time. Bring both interface approvals, immutable artifact digests, field-mitigation telemetry, the 2,400-journey ledger, every hard-stop event, and the open-risk list. Missing country pairs remain missing; they are not a provisional pass. We will decide whether targeting expands beyond the initial affected cohort.
turns.ko: 범위는 country evidence와 Wi-Fi rule transition으로 고정합니다. modem roaming selection, access-point firmware, location accuracy, 일반 Wi-Fi power policy는 변경하지 않습니다. 그쪽 발견은 별도 issue로 만듭니다. 첫 evidence checkpoint는 2026년 12월 2일 수요일 한국 표준시 20:00~20:45입니다. 두 interface approval, immutable artifact digest, field-mitigation telemetry, 2,400-journey ledger, 모든 hard-stop event, open-risk list를 가져오십시오. 빠진 country pair는 missing으로 남으며 provisional pass가 아닙니다. targeting을 initial affected cohort 너머로 확대할지 결정합니다.

turns.speaker: Liam Chen
turns.en: At the checkpoint I will replay a normal arrival, delayed stale snapshot, real second border crossing, dual-SIM switch, and complete loss of authoritative evidence. Reviewers will see that stale evidence cannot create a transaction and that journey-safe cannot expand a rule set. The ledger must reach one terminal result after process restart and callback duplication. A diagnostic upload failure cannot change regulatory state. I will also show expiry: when a verified token ages out, framework requests refresh before expansion and narrows safely if refresh fails. No timer alone can promote a country or convert uncertainty into confidence.
turns.ko: checkpoint에서 normal arrival, delayed stale snapshot, 실제 두 번째 border crossing, dual-SIM switch, authoritative evidence 완전 상실을 replay합니다. reviewer는 stale evidence가 transaction을 만들 수 없고 journey-safe가 rule set을 확장할 수 없음을 볼 것입니다. process restart와 callback duplication 뒤 ledger는 terminal result 하나에 도달해야 합니다. diagnostic upload failure가 regulatory state를 바꿔서는 안 됩니다. expiry도 보여드립니다. verified token이 만료되면 framework는 expansion 전에 refresh를 요청하고 refresh가 실패하면 안전하게 좁힙니다. timer만으로 country를 promote하거나 uncertainty를 confidence로 바꿀 수 없습니다.

turns.speaker: Elena Rossi
turns.en: I will demonstrate an expansion, a restriction, an equal-scope update, a duplicate, a bad signature, and an unavailable regulatory engine. For each case, the acknowledgment must match the applied table, not merely the requested table. Delaying acknowledgment may hold the transaction pending, but it may never cause framework to assume expansion. A firmware restart reloads the pinned policy bundle, reports its active digest, and requires reconciliation before accepting another expansion. If reconciliation fails, radios use journey-safe. This ensures a reboot cannot quietly restore a permissive cached table from an earlier country.
turns.ko: expansion, restriction, equal-scope update, duplicate, bad signature, unavailable regulatory engine을 시연합니다. 각 경우 acknowledgment는 requested table이 아니라 applied table과 일치해야 합니다. acknowledgment 지연은 transaction을 pending에 둘 수 있지만 framework가 expansion을 가정하게 해서는 안 됩니다. firmware restart는 pinned policy bundle을 reload하고 active digest를 보고하며 다른 expansion을 받기 전에 reconciliation을 요구합니다. reconciliation이 실패하면 radio는 journey-safe를 사용합니다. reboot가 이전 country의 permissive cached table을 조용히 복원하지 못하게 합니다.

turns.speaker: Owen Miller
turns.en: My interim report will show coverage by country pair, evidence combination, chipset branch, SIM mode, and delay band. It will list missing cells and all distinct failures. We will use the predeclared stop rule without relaxing it after a near pass. Failed runs stay in the denominator, and corrected artifacts restart under new digests. Nonfatal reconnection tails continue to the planned sample count so we measure the distribution rather than optimize for one hotel network. Regulatory reviewers receive rule-set digests and channel classes, not travel histories, subscriber identifiers, cell data, access-point names, or precise times.
turns.ko: interim report는 country pair, evidence combination, chipset branch, SIM mode, delay band별 coverage를 보여줍니다. missing cell과 서로 다른 모든 failure를 나열합니다. near pass 뒤에도 완화하지 않고 predeclared stop rule을 사용합니다. failed run은 분모에 남고 corrected artifact는 새 digest 아래 다시 시작합니다. 치명적이지 않은 reconnection tail은 특정 hotel network 하나에 맞춰 optimize하지 않고 distribution을 측정하도록 계획 sample count까지 계속합니다. regulatory reviewer는 rule-set digest와 channel class를 받으며 travel history, subscriber identifier, cell data, access-point name, precise time은 받지 않습니다.

turns.speaker: Mina Park
turns.en: The final go or defer review is Monday, December 7, 2026, at 10:00 Korea Standard Time. Approval requires the full normal ledger, fault-injection ledger, regulatory sign-off, privacy review, mitigation results, and no unresolved hard stop. We will decide separately for W18 and W19 and for each country pair with complete evidence. The decision table will show coverage, compliance outcome, reconnection tail, fallback rate, and remaining risk for every approved cohort. Requests to prefer callback arrival time, expand without a token, merge ledgers across digests, or remotely force a country require a new decision meeting. Until approval, the mitigation remains limited to the named build and cohort. Please acknowledge owners and dates by 11:30 KST today. Thank you; the record is complete.
turns.ko: 최종 go 또는 defer review는 2026년 12월 7일 월요일 한국 표준시 10:00입니다. 승인은 전체 normal ledger, fault-injection ledger, regulatory sign-off, privacy review, mitigation result, unresolved hard stop 0건을 요구합니다. W18·W19와 complete evidence가 있는 각 country pair를 별도로 결정합니다. decision table은 승인할 각 cohort의 coverage, compliance outcome, reconnection tail, fallback rate, remaining risk를 보여줍니다. callback arrival time 우선, token 없는 expansion, digest 간 ledger 병합, 원격 country 강제 요청은 새 decision meeting이 필요합니다. 승인 전 mitigation은 지정된 build와 cohort로 제한됩니다. 오늘 KST 11:30까지 담당과 일정을 확인하십시오. 감사합니다. 기록을 마칩니다.

turns.speaker: Liam Chen
turns.en: One final clarification: the confidence model is evidence-driven, not timer-driven. A later callback with an older observation remains stale even after the device has waited an hour. Likewise, two weak hints do not automatically equal one authoritative source. The reconciliation code records why each signal was accepted, rejected, or held, and a reviewer can reproduce the decision from bounded fields. A timeout may request fresh evidence or trigger journey-safe operation, but it cannot convert uncertainty into confidence. If all sources disappear during an active connection, framework preserves only the safest common rule set and records the resulting service impact for the field dashboard.
turns.ko: 마지막으로 명확히 하겠습니다. confidence model은 timer가 아니라 evidence 기반입니다. 더 오래된 observation을 가진 늦은 callback은 단말이 한 시간을 기다린 뒤에도 stale입니다. 또한 약한 hint 두 개가 자동으로 authoritative source 하나와 같아지지 않습니다. reconciliation code는 각 signal이 수락·거부·보류된 이유를 기록하며 reviewer는 제한된 field로 결정을 재현할 수 있습니다. timeout은 fresh evidence를 요청하거나 journey-safe operation을 trigger할 수 있지만 uncertainty를 confidence로 바꿀 수 없습니다. active connection 중 모든 source가 사라지면 framework는 가장 안전한 common rule set만 유지하고 field dashboard에 service impact를 기록합니다.

expressions.example: Good morning. Field Quality, Connectivity Framework, Wi-Fi BSP and Firmware, and Carrier and Regulatory Validation are represented. We are reviewing reports that 6 GHz Wi-Fi disappears several minutes after a traveler lands, inserts a local SIM, and connects successfully to a hotel access point. The device initially selects the correct country, then silently returns to the previous region and disconnects. We need to distinguish a regulatory protection from an incorrect rollback. Today's outcome must define the authoritative evidence, a safe field mitigation, permanent ownership, measurable gates, and a dated follow-up. We will not trade regulatory compliance for a faster reconnection.
expressions.practice: Name the authoritative evidence before assigning ownership.

expressions.phrase: arrival time cannot override source age
expressions.meaning_ko: 도착 시각이 근거의 오래됨을 덮을 수 없다
expressions.usage_ko: 늦게 온 오래된 정보를 거부할 때
expressions.example: Framework must reject it before proposing a country transaction. Generation 68 is older than the accepted generation 73 for the same subscription epoch. Arrival time cannot override source age. I propose a monotonic evidence ledger keyed by subscription epoch and boot session. The ledger accepts a modem record only if its registration generation advances or if a new subscription epoch is proven. A service restart does not create a new epoch. If generation is absent, the record enters uncertain state and cannot loosen the current domain. It may request a live refresh, and during uncertainty the device keeps the intersection of current and world-safe channels.
expressions.practice: A late packet proves that arrival time cannot override source age.

expressions.example: I disagree with keeping the current domain during all uncertainty. If the traveler physically moved but neither modem generation nor location is ready, retaining a permissive departure domain could authorize a channel that is not legal at the destination. The safe baseline must never be broader than world domain when movement is plausible. We need a journey trigger: airplane-mode duration, SIM country change, large time-zone change, or loss of the previous network for more than four hours. After a journey trigger, uncertain evidence should narrow to world-safe operation until two independent signals agree or one high-authority live modem registration is verified.
expressions.practice: Define a journey trigger before clearing the regional cache.

expressions.usage_ko: 안전을 위해 허용 채널을 줄일 때
expressions.example: Firmware can support that policy if transitions are explicit. Today it receives country updates without a mode. Add transition classes: confirmed-country, journey-safe, stale-rejected, and emergency-restrict. Journey-safe maps to a signed world-safe rule set and disables 6 GHz without pretending a specific country. Confirmed-country may expand only after framework provides a verified evidence token. Emergency-restrict can immediately remove channels on regulatory risk. Firmware must never expand from a timeout or missing token. It will return applied digest, radio impact, and reconnect reason. This makes protective narrowing visible and separates it from an accidental rollback.
expressions.practice: The rollback is protective narrowing, not a feature loss.

expressions.usage_ko: 반드시 지킬 설계 원칙을 말할 때
expressions.example: Framework accepts option three with a strict invariant: only verified evidence can broaden the rule set, while uncertainty can only preserve or narrow it. The evidence token contains subscription epoch, registration generation, source class, observation-age band, journey identifier, candidate country, and policy version. It contains no coordinates, cell identifiers, access-point identifiers, or raw timestamps. A commit requires either live modem registration plus a matching subscription country, or live modem registration plus coarse network-location agreement. Conflicts remain journey-safe and create a bounded diagnostic. Every transaction ends as applied, stale-rejected, conflict-safe, expired, superseded, or firmware-failed.
expressions.practice: Verified signatures are a strict invariant for promotion.

expressions.example: The decision is option three. We will deploy a field mitigation that detects a lower modem generation after a committed destination and moves only that device to journey-safe. It cannot assign a country, bypass token verification, or expand channels. The permanent fix is a monotonic evidence ledger, explicit journey boundary, verified expansion token, signed policy bundle, and reason-coded firmware acknowledgment. I own the incident record, affected-build targeting, customer-impact dashboard, and go or defer recommendation. Any evidence of illegal transmission stops the mitigation and escalates immediately; ordinary fallback to 5 GHz remains a measured customer-impact event, not a compliance failure.
expressions.practice: Return a reason-coded firmware acknowledgment for every update.

expressions.usage_ko: 낡은 상태가 적용되는 결함을 말할 때
expressions.example: Validation will run 9,600 journeys across six country pairs, physical and simulated SIM changes, modem restarts, airplane-mode periods of one to twelve hours, dual-SIM swaps, missing location, conflicting location, and delayed indications up to thirty minutes. Acceptance requires zero illegal-channel dwell, zero expansion without a verified token, zero stale-generation commits, and exactly one terminal result per transaction. A confirmed destination must restore permitted 6 GHz within twenty seconds at p99. Journey-safe entry must occur within two seconds of a risk trigger. Unrelated 2.4 and 5 GHz traffic may not pause longer than 150 milliseconds unless a restriction requires channel evacuation.
expressions.practice: The test must catch stale-generation commits.
